nodes.text: You throw yourself back on the bed, and before you know it, you've drifted off, exhausted, into a fitful night's sleep...
You pick up the hairbrush, feeling its weight in your hands, and sit back on the bed.
In your mind, you remember your mother sitting behind you, running this same brush through your hair.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: There's my pretty $CADY. Look at how beautiful you are with your hair like this!
Without even realizing it, your cheeks have flushed and tears have welled up in your eyes...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh... Mom...
You pick up the framed photo, looking into the eyes of your father, a man you barely knew, and sit down on the bed...
In your mind, you remember when your mother came in, doubled over with grief and bringing news of his passing.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $CADY, I'm so sorry... But something terrible has happened and...
Without even realizing it, your cheeks have flushed and tears have welled up in your eyes...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh... Dad...
You pick up the broken video game system and sit down on the bed. You run your thumb across the cracked screen...
In your mind, you remember your brother lying behind you lengthwise across the bed and playing games while you tried to finish your homework...

nodes.speaker: Brother
nodes.text: I can't go yet! I have to finish one more level!
Without even realizing it, your cheeks have flushed and tears have welled up in your eyes...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh... Brian...
...And stop dead in your tracks.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Simon, this room. This is my room. The same room that I used to live in... Back before...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Before what?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Never mind... I just... I never thought I'd see it again.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Pretty neat, huh? All the rooms here do it. It's a sympathetic decoration spell.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Apparently, when you think about being at peace, you think about coming here.
Simon surveys the room appraisingly and nods.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Not too shabby...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Of course, my room has 3 videogame systems, a flatscreen tv, two turntables, and a mini-fridge, but then again, we can't all have my impeccable knack for Feng Schway.
Simon surveys the room appraisingly. His eyes move from a dusty window sill to a pile of dirty, smelly laundry in the corner...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Not bad, but not too tidy...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Next time you get a room, you should definitely try to be a little nicer...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Trust me! It pays off!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Of course, my room has 3 videogame systems, a flatscreen tv, two turntables, and a mini-fridge!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's also got a life-sized cardboard cutout of Arinna, but, uh... That's just between you and me.
In the distance, a clock tower chimes.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That's the bell. I gotta head back to my room for bed check, but I'll see you around, okay?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: And you know, if you `did` happen to talk to Arinna...?
nodes.text_bbcode: And you know, if you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] happen to talk to Arinna...?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'll tell her you're not a total jerk... Maybe.
Simon turns and steps out of the room.
Looking around, your eyes settle on the dresser.
On top are several items: an ivory hairbrush, a framed photograph of your father, and a portable video game player with a cracked screen. You pick up the...
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, pleased to meet you?
In reply, the door creaks open cheerily. You enter...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This door better not talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well, you're out of luck...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Here at Spellclaive everything talks!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It does?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Most of the time it's pretty okay, but sometimes your toothbrush starts screaming, 'Help me! My face is being rubbed around in a disgusting mouth! `...Gllgg! Gllgg!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: Most of the time it's pretty okay, but sometimes your toothbrush starts screaming, 'Help me! My face is being rubbed around in a disgusting mouth! [color=#e23b3b][i]...Gllgg! Gllgg!'[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...That's a joke, right?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Kind of... Mostly... Not really?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Quick, just say hello before your room gets offended and locks you out for the rest of the semester.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, pleased to meet you, Mr. Room...?
In reply, the door creaks open. You enter...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Wait a second... She's a `princess` and an elfish-vampire-lady-thing? You really like to shoot for the moon, don't you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... She's a [color=#3b78e2][i]princess[/i][/color] and an elfish-vampire-lady-thing? You really like to shoot for the moon, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Just keep it down, okay? The other door is your bedroom.
You reach down to the doorknob and grab it. You feel electricity surge into your palm! You yank your hand back and shake it out.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Ow! What was that?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Kind of a get-to-know-you thing, like a handshake. $CADY, meet Room. Room, meet $CADY. Go ahead. Say hello.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: How... How did you know?
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Duh. Kind of obvious. You just happened to bump into me after class to show me to `her` room. Might as well be written on your face.
nodes.text_bbcode: Duh. Kind of obvious. You just happened to bump into me after class to show me to [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] room. Might as well be written on your face.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...But it's not, is it? It's not written on my face?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: One time Elijah fell asleep at a party, and the guys wrote on his face with `permental marker...`
nodes.text_bbcode: One time Elijah fell asleep at a party, and the guys wrote on his face with [color=#e23b3b][i]permental marker...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: So it was `permental!` It showed everything that he was thinking for months! And we're teenage guys. We only think about one thing!
nodes.text_bbcode: So it was [color=#e23b3b][i]permental![/i][/color] It showed everything that he was thinking for months! And we're teenage guys. We only think about one thing!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: And the last thing I need is for everyone to see that I have a crush on Princess Arinna.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: You could try, I guess, but I doubt Priam will let you get anywhere near her. Everytime I try to say hi, he yanks her away for security purposes...
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh. Fine. I like my privacy, anyway.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: But I mean, if you `did` somehow happen to talk to Arinna, could you tell her I said hi?
nodes.text_bbcode: But I mean, if you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] somehow happen to talk to Arinna, could you tell her I said hi?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Is this... Do you have a crush on Arinna? Grow a pair!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Please don't tell anyone. The last thing I need is for everyone to find out that I like Princess Arinna.
As you answer, the fire winks out!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ignis... Confla... Gratus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ignis... Confla... Gratus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A small floating `ball of flame` appears in the palm of your hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: A small floating [b]ball of flame[/b] appears in the palm of your hand!

nodes.text: A small floating `ball of flame` appears in the palm of your hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: A small floating [b]ball of flame[/b] appears in the palm of your hand!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Focus on your feelings, $CADY, and try again. Remember... `Ignis... Confla... Gratus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Focus on your feelings, $CADY, and try again. Remember... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ignis... Confla... Gratus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Very well! `Ice Blast` it is! Now hold out your hand and repeat these words... `Frigo... Glaci... Alis!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Very well! [color=#e23b3b][i]Ice Blast[/i][/color] it is! Now hold out your hand and repeat these words... [color=#e23b3b][i]Frigo... Glaci... Alis!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Very well! `Fire Render` it is. Now hold out your hand and repeat these words... `Ignis... Confla... Gratus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Very well! [color=#e23b3b][i]Fire Render[/i][/color] it is. Now hold out your hand and repeat these words... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ignis... Confla... Gratus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang claps and shuffles backward to the center of the room. He clears his throat dramatically...
Then lowers his voice to a deep, gravelly register.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Magic exists in the great duality between `Order` and `Chaos...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Magic exists in the great duality between [color=#e23b3b][i]Order[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]Chaos...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Between beginnings and endings, the objective and the subjective, the icy calm of intellect and the white-hot flames of passion.
Spellmaster Ang holds out one open palm, revealing an orb of floating blue water that freezes over into pure, white frost!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: I give you `ORDER...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I give you [color=#e23b3b][i]ORDER...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: In the other hand, Spellmaster Ang reveals a clump of floating lava rock that erupts into a ball of brilliant flame!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: ...And `CHAOS!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And [color=#e23b3b][i]CHAOS![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You step back from the heat and cold. Spellmaster Ang stretches his arms out to either side...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: These are the `two sides` to magic. A young magician may walk both paths for a time, but sooner or later, he or she must `choose` a path, or else risk...
nodes.text_bbcode: These are the [color=#e23b3b][i]two sides[/i][/color] to magic. A young magician may walk both paths for a time, but sooner or later, he or she must [color=#e23b3b][i]choose[/i][/color] a path, or else risk...

nodes.text: Ang claps his hands together! There is a brilliant flash of light, and when he holds up his hands again, they are totally empty.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: ...Becoming nothing!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Okay, that was pretty awesome. You're telling me that `I` can do all that?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Okay, that was pretty awesome. You're telling me that [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] can do all that?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: My darling $CADY, this is a school for magic! With the proper instruction and time, you can do `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: My darling $CADY, this is a school for magic! With the proper instruction and time, you can do [color=#e23b3b][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang holds out his hands to take yours. You give him your wrist, and he clasps a silver bracelet to it. The bracelet is adorned with a large stone in a shimmering color you can't quite discern.
The bracelet contracts, cinching tightly around your wrist--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Get it off! That hurts! It--
The bracelet relaxes, and when it does, the stone has assumed a luxurious, ultramarine hue.
The bracelet relaxes, and when it does, the stone has assumed a sultry, vermillion hue.
The bracelet relaxes, and when it does, the stone has assumed an aloof, almost neutral yellow hue.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So... I figure I'm going to be saying this a lot around here, but that was new. What is this thing?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: The gem on the bracelet is a Motus Traduxi, a tell-tale, and the color tells me that you have a calm, logical mind...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: The gem on the bracelet is a Motus Traduxi, a tell-tale, and the color tells me that you brim over with `great passion...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The gem on the bracelet is a Motus Traduxi, a tell-tale, and the color tells me that you brim over with [color=#e23b3b][i]great passion...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: The gem on the bracelet is a Motus Traduxi, a tell-tale, and the color you seem to be an extremely balanced soul...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So it's a rock that tells my `mood?` That's fun. What else did you find at the bottom of your box of cereal?
nodes.text_bbcode: So it's a rock that tells my [color=#3b78e2][i]mood?[/i][/color] That's fun. What else did you find at the bottom of your box of cereal?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Not just your mood, your `essential nature...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not just your mood, your [color=#e23b3b][i]essential nature...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Magic is not just something a person learns. It flows from the core of your being...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: And according to the Motus Traduxi, you are predisposed to following the path of `Order.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And according to the Motus Traduxi, you are predisposed to following the path of [color=#e23b3b][i]Order.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So the magic rock knows I'm good at the Sunday crossword, and that's it... Free will goes right out the window?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Of course not... This reading does not preclude you from aligning yourself with Chaos, but if you do, your path will be more difficult...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: And according to the Motus Traduxi, you are predisposed to following the path of `Chaos.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And according to the Motus Traduxi, you are predisposed to following the path of [color=#e23b3b][i]Chaos.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So the magic rock thinks I'm an emo frontman, and that's it... Free will goes right out the window?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Of course not... This does not preclude you from aligning yourself with Order, but if you do, your path will be harder...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: And according to Motus Traduxi, you are predisposed to Order and Chaos in equal measure.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So the magic rock says I'm well-balanced... Duh!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Even so... For you, especially, the choices you make will define you...
You look down at the bracelet, gazing at the light skimming off its round surface...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay... I think I get it...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Good... And fortunately for you, there's still plenty of time before you must dedicate yourself exclusively to one path.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: For now, let's just start by choosing your first spell. Which will it be?
Spellmaster Ang twists his wrist, creating a coin of pure-white frost that rolls across his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Do you want to learn `Ice Blast`, a spell of Order?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you want to learn [color=#e23b3b][i]Ice Blast[/i][/color], a spell of Order?

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang snaps! The coin erupts into steam and then a plume of narrow candle flame appears!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: ...Or `Fire Render`, a spell of Chaos?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Or [color=#e23b3b][i]Fire Render[/i][/color], a spell of Chaos?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Yes! How did you know?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Seemed pretty obvious.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Very good! I can see you're a quick study! My point is, if I did it for them... `I can do it for you too!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Very good! I can see you're a quick study! My point is, if I did it for them... [color=#e23b3b][i]I can do it for you too![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You wait patiently for Spellmaster Ang to continue.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: ...How to? `...Well?`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, did you want me to answer...?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Hmm... Not so quick, but she seems polite. I can work with that. My point is, if I did it for them... `I can do it for you too!`
You and Luke round a corner...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: So it's kind of strange that you didn't know you had magical abilities before we picked you up...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Most students here figured out one or two spells on their own. The Council detected the unauthorized use of magic, and then Cromwell sent out students to bring them in.
You close your eyes and think back to everything you could never explain, to everything you dismissed as impossible...
Not just at your former school, but further back. To the day it all began. The day you traveled beyond your own world...
And ran afoul of a creature that still stalks your dreams.

nodes.speaker: Beast
nodes.text: `ROOAARR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]ROOAARR!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, well... There might've been some clues. What about you? What did you figure out how to do?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Well, funny story, I was at camp a few summers ago, and we were in the middle of this huge water balloon fight--
A bell rings, and a tide of students surges into the halls. A clutch of several cute girls passes nearby, beaming at Luke.

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Hey Luke! We missed you in Spelligraphy. Did you want to come over and look at my notes later?

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Uh no... Luke and I need to study for our History of Hexes midterm.

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Isn't that right, Luke?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Ladies! Please! Contain yourselves! I'm on an errand for the Headmaster. I'm showing $CADY here to her first class.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh... Hi?

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Uh... Hi. Now Luke, about those notes I took...?

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: No, what about studying with me...?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Okay, listen... There's more than enough of me to go around! And if it turns out that there isn't--

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `Duo... Dupli... Care!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Duo... Dupli... Care![/i][/color]

nodes.text: There is a flash, and Luke now stands next to a copy of himself.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: ...See?

nodes.speaker: Girl
nodes.text: Hee! That's really great!
The `real` Luke turns away from the girls, guiding you through the mob toward the far end of the hall. His doppelganger continues to chat with the girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [b]real[/b] Luke turns away from the girls, guiding you through the mob toward the far end of the hall. His doppelganger continues to chat with the girls.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Anyway, as I was saying, we were in the middle of this enormous water balloon fight and all of a sudden--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Did you just... Clone yourself?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: What? Oh, no, not really. It's just an illusion. That one will dissolve into thin air in, like, thirty seconds. But hey, it'll keep them occupied, right?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Heh... You think you're really cool, don't you? A real ladies' man?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh, well, you know, I mean, I guess I have a bit of a reputation...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And are you flirting with me right now?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: That's... Kind of a loaded question...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah. That's what I thought.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: There's something you need to know about `me.` I'm not like those girls. You can't just charm me with your funny stories and then pawn me off with some cheap trick when the next cute thing walks by.
nodes.text_bbcode: There's something you need to know about [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color] I'm not like those girls. You can't just charm me with your funny stories and then pawn me off with some cheap trick when the next cute thing walks by.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Just take me to my class, okay?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Sure...
You and Luke walk the rest of the way in silence.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Anyway, this is your stop. `Magic 101` as taught by Spellmaster Ang. He's a little full of himself, but he's also a really powerful magician...
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, this is your stop. [color=#e23b3b][i]Magic 101[/i][/color] as taught by Spellmaster Ang. He's a little full of himself, but he's also a really powerful magician...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: You should try to do what he tells you.
You slip inside a dim, empty classroom and spy an instructor preening in front of a wall mirror. He licks his fingertip and then uses it to flatten out his immaculately plucked eyebrows.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Well, look at you, you handsome devil...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh... Excuse me?
Spellmaster Ang whips around, startled.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Uh, not `you`, whoever you are. I was actually referring to, er...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, not [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color], whoever you are. I was actually referring to, er...

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang glances toward the mirror.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: ...Never mind! What can I do for you, child!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm $CADY, your new student. Headmaster Cromwell sent me here for my first spell class.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Did she now...?
Spellmaster Ang glances over to a tall stack of unread and unexamined scrolls on his desk. He shuffles through the top few pages, tossing them aside.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Memo on divination... Remember to lower the toilet seat in the faculty restroom... New student...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Well, heh... As you can see, I'm very busy. But I am happy to say that you have most certainly come to the right place!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: As you know, it was I who taught Cedric Serpentslayer how to slay serpents! It was I who taught Tolliver Troghunter how to hunt trogs! And it was I who taught Milo the Mummybinder how to--

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: You'd think so, right? You know what's not funny? Trying to get the taste of glitter out of your mouth.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You've `got` to teach me that spell.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've [color=#3b78e2][i]got[/i][/color] to teach me that spell.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yeah... And why should I trust you with that kind of magic? I've only known you for how long?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: That's kind of weird. Why would I remind you `not` to do something?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's kind of weird. Why would I remind you [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] to do something?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: And wait, are you saying you did want to kiss me otherwise?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey! Don't twist my words around...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: It's okay, $CADY! I'm just messing with you!
You set the quill down and push the scroll away.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Look, I don't know how you people are doing all of this, or what it is you want from me, but I'm not falling for it. Take me home. Now.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: To your foster family?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Why not? They're jerks, but at least they're not `lying` jerks.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why not? They're jerks, but at least they're not [color=#3b78e2][i]lying[/i][/color] jerks.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Very well. As you wish...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You're... You're not going to try to talk me out of it?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: The first rule of magic is a simple one: `you must believe.` Without belief in the impossible, only the possible remains.
nodes.text_bbcode: The first rule of magic is a simple one: [color=#3b78e2][i]you must believe.[/i][/color] Without belief in the impossible, only the possible remains.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Right, well... `Obviously.` If it were possible, it wouldn't be impossible.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right, well... [color=#3b78e2][i]Obviously.[/i][/color] If it were possible, it wouldn't be impossible.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: No, it wouldn't...
Cromwell snaps her fingers, and the world begins to shake. Lights on the walls blink on and off. Books fall. A rushing sound grows louder and louder and then...
`SCREEEECHHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SCREEEECHHH!!![/b]

nodes.text: You look up, and you're sitting on pavement in front of your old school. The grill of the large, older model SUV brakes just inches from your face. Students are standing around staring.
The mysterious guy you had spoken to is nowhere to be found.

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: See? I told you Foster Care was a total freak!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whu... What happened?
In the weeks and months that follow, you'll convince yourself it was all a dream, that the impossible does not happen. That only the possible can be.
But on the dark, still nights, when the whole sky seems charged with unnatural energy, you'll wonder...
`What... If...?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]What... If...?[/b]

nodes.text: You have failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: You sign your name, and as you complete the stroke, you feel energy surge from your hand and through your body...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That tingled!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Congratulations. You just officially enrolled in SpellClaive Academy. Your accommodations are being prepared as we speak...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But before you get settled, how would you feel about attending your first class?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Do I have a choice?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Definitely not!
Cromwell snaps, and the door opens. The tall, attractive guy who rescued you steps in.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey. You're awake.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I thought you might prefer a familiar face to show you around the campus. $CADY, this is--
Cromwell waves her hand to indicate the window and the school grounds beyond.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: The price of admittance is your ordinary life. Once you enroll there will be no going back.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Lady, have you `seen` my life?
nodes.text_bbcode: Lady, have you [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] my life?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Some of it. Enough to regret not tracking you down sooner...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But even with the hardships you've endured, there may come a time when you regret accepting my offer. Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: No one ever really does.
Cromwell flicks a finger, and a quill pen floats out of the ink well. It levitates into your open hand. Cromwell rotates the scroll to face you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Before you can be enrolled, you must do one last thing. Sign your name here on the class registry.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Right here on the line?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Yes. Well...?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I mean, you're talking about a school for kids with magical powers! And you're saying I'm one of them... `Me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, you're talking about a school for kids with magical powers! And you're saying I'm one of them... [color=#3b78e2][i]Me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Yes, I am, and this school truly is amazing. More than you may ever know.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But... But you do know that I don't have any money, right?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I do, and even if you did have money, you wouldn't be prepared to pay in the currency we require.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Think of this as a scholarship. For someone from whom we expect great things.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No pressure...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But you should be warned. There `is` a cost...
nodes.text_bbcode: But you should be warned. There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a cost...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Nobody does anything for free. What's this going to cost me?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Not one cent... Not one yen... Not one tharni...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Tharni?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, it's my job to be here. Not just for you, but for all students with the potential to become great magicians.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But since you asked, yes, there is a cost...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I knew it.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Is that right? What about the snake earlier? How did it appear?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I didn't do that. Luke just said `words` and...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't do that. Luke just said [color=#3b78e2][i]words[/i][/color] and...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And then what? Can you explain it?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I don't understand your phrasing, but I suspect it is insulting!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Priam, that will be quite enough! $CADY and I have a great deal to discuss.
Priam harumphs once more and continues out into the hallway. Cromwell beckons inward.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, please come in.
You join Cromwell in her office. She walks around behind her large cherry desk and takes a seat. There is no computer, no telephone, just a large paper scroll and an ink quill...
Looking closer, you notice that the handwritten words appear and scroll vertically like incoming texts.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: So I imagine you have questions for me.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Actually, I already caught the highlights from your Away Team.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This is supposed to be some kind of magic school. You're supposed to be some kind of big deal headmaster...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I see... I imagine that defensiveness has served you well, kept you from getting hurt... `Again...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I see... I imagine that defensiveness has served you well, kept you from getting hurt... [color=#3b78e2][i]Again...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell rises, steps toward the window, and indicates the grounds beyond.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So where are we, some kind of magic land?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Upstate New York, actually. But good guess...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: The existence of magic is a closely-guarded secret, and until practitioners learn to master their abilities, they come here to SpellClaive...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, this is a home for students like you. It's a place where you can study, possibly even make friends...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Someday, you might even call it a `home...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Someday, you might even call it a [color=#3b78e2][i]home...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Home?` Trust me, I've been in more than enough of `those...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Home?[/i][/color] Trust me, I've been in more than enough of [color=#3b78e2][i]those...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And friends like that creepy guy who just stormed out of here? What `was` he, anyway?
nodes.text_bbcode: And friends like that creepy guy who just stormed out of here? What [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] he, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It's a long story, one I'm sure you'll hear soon enough. For now, I'd like to think more about developing your talents.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: People keep saying that... What `talents?` The only thing I'm good at is getting into trouble.
nodes.text_bbcode: People keep saying that... What [color=#3b78e2][i]talents?[/i][/color] The only thing I'm good at is getting into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm totally standing right here.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Yes, I know, and as Precept of the Wildefolk and Ward of the Throne, I speak my mind.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Really? You speak your mind? It's a wonder you're not a lot quieter!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Plus you're like totally wearing a bathrobe!

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Impudent girl! These are the robes of my station. I am Precept of the Wildefolk, Ward of the Throne!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: The porcelain one? Because that would totally jibe with your post-shower getup.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Headmaster `who?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Headmaster [color=#3b78e2][i]who?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Cromwell. You know, like Oliver Cromwell. Well, his illegitimate older sister actually...
Several angry administrators scurry in your direction!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh, guys? Are we going to stand around asking questions, or are we gonna get out of here?
The administrators gain ground, their voices rising up over the commotion to yell your name!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: For the record, I think you're both totally full of it...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But cutting class beats detention any day.
Luke leads you and Simon over to an older, rusty sedan. He snaps, and the rear door pops open for you. You climb in, your legs scraping along the ripped vinyl.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oww... Are you sure this rust factory even starts?
Luke taps the wheel and turns the key in the ignition.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Starts? This baby is the fastest hunk of junk in the whole Galacticum Maleficorum...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: That's a `spellbook.` Also sort of a movie quote...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's a [color=#e23b3b][i]spellbook.[/i][/color] Also sort of a movie quote...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Heh... What Luke's trying to say is that he's made a few minor `magifications` to factory specs.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh... What Luke's trying to say is that he's made a few minor [color=#e23b3b][i]magifications[/i][/color] to factory specs.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Remember when I said this would be more fun than detention? I'm starting to have second thoughts...
The principal arrives along the side of the car. He pounds on the hood and points at you, gesturing for you to get out.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Actually, what I'm trying to say is... `HANG ON!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, what I'm trying to say is... [color=#e23b3b][i]HANG ON![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Luke steps on the gas, and $CADY is thrown against her seat by the acceleration. The world outside the window strobes into a disorienting, horizontal blur!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: UHHHH!
Simon looks back over the seat.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Did... Did New Girl just faint?
Luke checks in the rear view mirror, watching you slumber peacefully.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Looks like!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh... So what are you waiting for then? Time to really hit the gas!
Luke shifts into high gear. There are several creaky pops from underneath the hood. Then the world seems to freeze, and the car lurches forward like a bolt of lightning!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: `SWEEEEEEET!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]SWEEEEEEET!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You wake with your face pressed again soft, luxuriant leather.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Hnh!
Sitting up, you realize that you're lying on a couch in a hallway. The floors are polished hardwood, the walls are wallpapered. The decor reminds you of a beautiful East Coast university.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Where am I?
You rise and peer out the window across from you.

You're on the second floor, looking down at people your own age milling about on an expansive, green lawn. One student in a circle points skyward, and a firework erupts from his fingertips. It explodes into the shape of an electric guitar that plays an audible power chord!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Whoa!
You stumble back from the window and trip over your own feet, collapsing into a heap.
You struggle to remember how you got here. Some memories come back... Chloe, the snake, the SUV frozen in time by a pocketwatch, and a mention of a headmaster named--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Cromwell?
You scan the hallway. At the end is a door with a nameplate reading `'A. Cromwell'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You scan the hallway. At the end is a door with a nameplate reading [b]'A. Cromwell'.[/b]

nodes.text: Through the ajar door, you spy a woman in an impeccably tailored suit.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Must we go through this again, Priam?
You crane your head to see who she's talking to. It's an exceptionally tall, strapping younger man in white, flowing robes. His attire seems elegant, but savage somehow... Warlike.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I must again register my disapproval, Headmaster. This is hardly the time to accept new students, especially one of such questionable character.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Priam. Are you trying to tell me which students I should accept into `my` school?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, Priam. Are you trying to tell me which students I should accept into [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] school?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: No, of course not. I am offering counsel. This is a time of war after all!
You jerk back, noticing for the first time the man's curved ears, his fanged teeth, his red eyes.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: He's... He's not human!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Why am I not weirded out by that?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Your `counsel` is appreciated. But the war is in the Wilde, and my school is not.
nodes.text_bbcode: Your [color=#3b78e2][i]counsel[/i][/color] is appreciated. But the war is in the Wilde, and my school is not.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And as long as the doors remain open, I shall endeavor to educate, care for, and protect `all` young magic users... Regardless of convenience. That `also` goes for your sister...
nodes.text_bbcode: And as long as the doors remain open, I shall endeavor to educate, care for, and protect [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] young magic users... Regardless of convenience. That [color=#3b78e2][i]also[/i][/color] goes for your sister...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Of course.
Cromwell glances over to the door and spies you peeking in.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Speaking of students... Precept, I think we'll need to continue this conversation some other time. If you'll excuse us...
Priam harumphs and turns. As he steps out the door, he eyes you contemptuously.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Scrawny. Slack-jawed. You don't exactly `look` like Spellclaive Academy material.
nodes.text_bbcode: Scrawny. Slack-jawed. You don't exactly [color=#e23b3b][i]look[/i][/color] like Spellclaive Academy material.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You mean that was a spell? `You` made that snake appear?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean that was a spell? [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] made that snake appear?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yep...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...And I can do that too?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Spellclaive Academy. It's a school where magic users like us can go to learn spells and hone our abilities.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But I'm not a magic user...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, magic users... You know, like `you` are?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, magic users... You know, like [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] are?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, I think you've got the wrong girl, buddy. The only magic I know is how to disappear from detention.
Simon looks at Luke with exasperation.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: God! Please tell me she's not a total noob!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: $CADY, have you even cast a spell before today?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, how would I...?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Listen, it's okay. We'll just get her to Headmaster Cromwell at Spellclaive Academy, and she can explain everything.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Appareo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Appareo![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The pressure in your fingers releases with explosive force, but nothing at all seems to happen.

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Wait for it... Wait for it...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Idos...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Idos...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The roiling sensation of energy moves from your shoulders down into your hands. A pressure grows in your fingertips, like a balloon over-filling with air!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Aspi...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aspi...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You feel a strange surge of energy flow through your body, starting deep inside you and radiating out into your shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What the...?

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Don't stop. Next word: `Idos...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't stop. Next word: [color=#e23b3b][i]Idos...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: One year later...
You sit in the office of the guidance counselor at Costa Mesa High, staring bored out a window. He stands in front of you, a concerned look on his face.

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: Oh, $CADY... What `are` we going to do about you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, $CADY... What [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] we going to do about you?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: You transferred to Costa Mesa just four months ago, and already, you've been suspended three times!
He flips open your folder...

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: Fighting in the halls, cutting class, and... Threatening to set Chloe James' hair on fire? What would your family think?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: My family wouldn't say anything. They're `dead.`
nodes.text_bbcode: My family wouldn't say anything. They're [color=#3b78e2][i]dead.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: I apologize... I'm aware of your tragedy, I meant to say 'your foster family'. Your `new` home.
nodes.text_bbcode: I apologize... I'm aware of your tragedy, I meant to say 'your foster family'. Your [color=#e23b3b][i]new[/i][/color] home.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I don't have a `home...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't have a [color=#3b78e2][i]home...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: Look, $CADY, I'm going to level with you. If you keep this up, you'll be expelled. `Again.` And at this rate, I don't know any other school in the area that will take you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, $CADY, I'm going to level with you. If you keep this up, you'll be expelled. [color=#e23b3b][i]Again.[/i][/color] And at this rate, I don't know any other school in the area that will take you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So? Maybe that's for the best!

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: ...I've seen your test scores, $CADY. I've talked to your old teachers. I `know` that this isn't you. You're capable of `so` much more...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...I've seen your test scores, $CADY. I've talked to your old teachers. I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] that this isn't you. You're capable of [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] much more...

nodes.text: You look away, refusing to meet his gaze. He takes a seat in front of you.

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: What happened with your mother and brother was absolutely tragic... But you can't let it destroy your life as well! You're so much better than that.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...You don't know me.

nodes.speaker: Guidance Counselor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You don't know who I am. You `don't` know what I went through. You can't even begin to imagine.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't know who I am. You [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] know what I went through. You can't even begin to imagine.

nodes.text: You remember that day... Running through the woods... The hot breath of the beast on your back... The memories that feel `so` real but can't possibly be true...
nodes.text_bbcode: You remember that day... Running through the woods... The hot breath of the beast on your back... The memories that feel [b]so[/b] real but can't possibly be true...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It's my life. And I'll do what I want.
As the guidance counselor stammers, you yank your messenger bag onto your shoulder and storm outside.
Outside, you lean up against a wall and let out a deep exhale...
When suddenly, you see a tall pretty cheerleader stalking your way from down the field, a furious look on her face!

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: Where is she?! Where is that thieving gutter trash?
Immediately, you bolt up and take off, sprinting towards the edge of campus!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Out of the way! Move! Coming through!
Before you can reach the parking lot, a tall, handsome guy you've never met steps out in front of you!

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Uh, hey, you're $CADY, right?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Listen, we don't have much time. I need to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Is this a joke?

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: What? No? Why would it be a joke to talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Miss the meme? Good-looking preps like you aren't exactly friendly with girls like me.

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Not with that attitude...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Now if you don't mind, I kind of need to get moving before--

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: `Hey! $CADY! Don't you move!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hey! $CADY! Don't you move![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The crowd parts, turning to the shrill voice coming from the door. The cheerleader follows, flanked by two friends.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Away. See?
You turn and push past the cute guy.

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: $CADY, it's actually really important that we--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, whatever.
You only get a few steps before the cheerleader strides after you, grips your bag by the strap, and yanks. You stumble to the ground, and she rips it right off your shoulder.
You scramble up to your feet...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Give me back my bag, `now,` or I swear to god, I will break your arm...
nodes.text_bbcode: Give me back my bag, [color=#3b78e2][i]now,[/i][/color] or I swear to god, I will break your arm...

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: Bring it, gutter trash!
Before you can throw a punch, the guy moves in to intervene.
The cheerleader digs in the messenger bag and pulls out a shiny silver hand mirror. She shows it to her friends.

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: See? I told you guys that `Foster Care` was a thief!
nodes.text_bbcode: See? I told you guys that [color=#3b78e2][i]Foster Care[/i][/color] was a thief!

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Hey, Chloe was it? Look, you got your mirror back. Give it a rest, okay?

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: You're seriously defending her? Well, too bad. We're not done yet. I want to know if this serial klepto stole anything else.
Chloe continues to rifle through the messenger bag.

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: $CADY, do you trust me?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Met you five seconds ago... So that would be a `no.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Met you five seconds ago... So that would be a [color=#3b78e2][i]no.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Close enough. Now repeat the followings words: `Aspi...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Close enough. Now repeat the followings words: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aspi...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Just repeat after me. Say the word `Aspi`...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just repeat after me. Say the word [color=#e23b3b][i]Aspi[/i][/color]...`

nodes.text: You feel a jolt, a powerful jerk to the side, and you're thrown to the ground, landing hard on black asphalt...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `UHFF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]UHFF![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You open your mouth, suck in a lungful of air, and...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `HEEEEELLLP!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]HEEEEELLLP!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The beast gnashes forward--
The beast gnashes forward--
The instant before his teeth can penetrate your flesh, you take a big step back! There's a quick rush of wind, a feeling of weightlessness, and then...
The beast gnashes forward--
The instant before his teeth can rend into your flesh, you let go of the roots! There's a quick rush of wind, a feeling of weightlessness, and then...
You are frozen with fear, stammering, helpless...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh... Nh...
The beast gnashes forward--
The beast pursues, and the sounds it makes, the sounds of branches breaking and buried roots upended, draw ever closer...
You move faster and faster, trying to gain some ground, when...
You move faster and faster, trying to ignore the pain, when...
The path before you abruptly ends in a steep, vertical drop, a cliff that bottoms out in a rocky ravine several stories below!
You lurch to a stop at the edge of the cliff and gaze out across a lush, green savannah, and standing in the middle of it is...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Is that a... `Unicorn?` Where am I?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is that a... [color=#3b78e2][i]Unicorn?[/i][/color] Where am I?

nodes.text: You skid toward the edge, and the soft earth at the lip gives way beneath your feet. You drop sharply...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `AHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: At the last second, you frantically grab hold of a braid of tangled roots!
Your body jolts, but you do not fall.
Below you is a clutch of jagged rocks, but past that lies a lush, green savannah, and standing in the middle of it is...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Is that a... `Unicorn?` Where am I?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is that a... [color=#3b78e2][i]Unicorn?[/i][/color] Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Beast
nodes.text: `ROOAARR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]ROOAARR!!![/i]

nodes.text: You whip your head back toward the forest! The beast slinks forward, and for the first time, it can be viewed in its entirety...
You peek back over the ledge! The beast slinks forward, and for the first time, the creature can be viewed in its entirety...
Its body is that of a lion, its face oddly ape-like, with a writhing, snakelike tail. A forked-tongue darts out from between rows of sharp teeth...

nodes.speaker: Beast
nodes.text: `RRRRR...` Come now, there is no shame in meeting your fate.
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]RRRRR...[/i] Come now, there is no shame in meeting your fate.

nodes.text: The beast draws closer...
Your ankle inches backwards, testing the edge of the cliff. A small rock works loose, drops, and plinks soundlessly off the packed earth far below!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No. Please stop...
The beast's tongue slimes your cheek, and its jaws open wide to bite!
The paw whooshes by, just overhead...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Ahhh!
The beast lands with a thud, turns its head toward you, and wildly gnashes jaws lined with rows of massive teeth!

nodes.speaker: Beast
nodes.text: `RAAAWWWRRR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]RAAAWWWRRR!!![/i]

nodes.text: A gust of hot, rancid breath steams against your cheeks!
You scramble toward the edge of the clearing, find your feet, and sprint into the woods!
You hesitate, frozen with fear. The paw strikes your chest, batting you through the air like a rag doll!

You crash down in a rotted log at the lip of the forest, clamor to your feet, and wince as a flash of pain sears up from your side. Something inside feels broken, one rib, maybe two, and the jagged edges rub together with each new frantic movement...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ahhhh!`
Behind you, the beast growls and lumbers closer. You pivot toward the treeline and limp into the woods!
Your mother slows and stops for a red light, and then looks wistfully out into the distance with a soft, forlorn expression...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I keep thinking that if your father were still with us, maybe things wouldn't be quite so tight...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Maybe I'd be able to give you more.
Unconsciously, your hand drops to a heart-shaped pendant at your neck, and you rub the metal gently between your thumb and forefinger.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Mom, I'm sorry. I know you're doing the best you can.
The light blinks green. Your mother shifts her foot from the brake to the accelerator...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's okay, sweetie. I know it's silly, but sometimes I feel like your father is still out there, trying to say something--
There's a quick thump from behind you! You whip around!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Brian, cut it out! Can't you see that--
Just then, the blare of a horn catches your attention! A big rig barrels into the intersection, roaring through the red light!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Mom, look out! There's a car comin--
The truck jackhammers into the side of your family's sedan! There is a thunderclap, accompanied by tinkling chimes of shattering glass and the high-pitched shrieking of stressed metal!
Your stomach lurches, and the world seems to spin!
No, not the world... `You.` You're spinning, the ground below you, the sky above, as your car does a somersault through the air!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, not the world... [b]You.[/b] You're spinning, the ground below you, the sky above, as your car does a somersault through the air!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh god... Oh god...
The ground rushes up, the roof crushes inward, and...
You somehow land gently, impossibly gently, touching down on your hands and knees in a pile of dry grass.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I must've been thrown clear of the crash or...
Still unsteady, knees trembling, you push yourself upright and look around.
You're in a clearing alongside a dense woods, with no sign of the road in any direction. Great, gnarled trees arch over you, and past that, wispy golden clouds filigree the pink sky.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Mom... Brian...? `...MOM?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Mom... Brian...? [color=#3b78e2][i]...MOM?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The shout echoes deep into the woods, bouncing through the shadows. In reply, comes a deep guttural `growl.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The shout echoes deep into the woods, bouncing through the shadows. In reply, comes a deep guttural [b]growl.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Interesting. I'd believed my assignment to be a fool's errand, but you have arrived just as foretold.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Mom, is that...?

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: No, child. Your mother's not here.
Branches shake, leaves whip wildly, and something massive leaps off strong, muscled haunches and flies right at you!

nodes.speaker: Beast
nodes.text: `RAAAWWWRRR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]RAAAWWWRRR!!![/i]

nodes.text: You get one glimpse of a padded paw, like a tiger's, tipped with dagger-like talons, screaming toward you and...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sorry, I guess I just got excited...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh no, sweetie. You should be excited. Getting your license is a really big deal.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I wish I could do more, maybe help you get a car of your own, but the budget is stretched pretty thin right now...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $CADY!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What? All my friends get to drive whoever they want! `And` they all have their own cars!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? All my friends get to drive whoever they want! [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] they all have their own cars!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I don't care what your friends' parents are letting them do! I'm your mother, and in this family, we follow the rules.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And you `know` how tight our budget is. There's just no way we can afford a car for you right now!
nodes.text_bbcode: And you [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] how tight our budget is. There's just no way we can afford a car for you right now!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Right. Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Brother
nodes.text: Somebody's in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Your sister's not in trouble, Brian. And I'm sorry for snapping like that. I just...
Cromwell nods toward a rustic, wooden building on the perimeter of the campus.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I'd like you go to the Bestiary and speak to Beastmaster Kimuko. She'll help you select your new familiar.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Familiar... You mean like a `pet?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Familiar... You mean like a [color=#3b78e2][i]pet?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Headmaster, I don't know anything about animals. Most of the foster homes I lived in didn't allow them...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Well, a familiar is hardly a `pet.` It's more like a living extension of the magician it bonds with.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, a familiar is hardly a [color=#3b78e2][i]pet.[/i][/color] It's more like a living extension of the magician it bonds with.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It's a second pair of eyes and ears, a friend if you need one...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And I think you do.
Headmaster Cromwell bids you farewell, and you shuffle down the hillside toward the Bestiary.
Out front, a bit too far away to discern in any specific detail, you see a figure in a cloak entering through the stable doors.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, hey there! ...Professor Kimuko?
The figure vanishes inside. You double-time down the hill, finally coming to the door left slightly ajar. You peer inside the dark, musty stables...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `...Professor?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Professor?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: ...And then venture in.
The air is heavy with the musty smell of caged animals and damp straw, and on either side are heavy wooden stalls containing snorting, stomping beasts.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: If anybody can hear me, I'm supposed to be getting a familiar, and I'm pretty sure I might be lost.
There is a clatter from deep inside the stables. You step closer, and the figure in the dark cloak explodes out from the back room and shoves you backward against the wall. The figure keeps running!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey! What the heck was that...?!
You rub your tender, bruised shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you met any friends?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well... I met a few people.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That's good at least! Who?
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You know, `people.` Luke, Shy Guy, Prince McAngryFace and Princess ProbablyHasAName...
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, [color=#3b78e2][i]people.[/i][/color] Luke, Shy Guy, Prince McAngryFace and Princess ProbablyHasAName...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: These sound like very close friends...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What do you want from me?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I don't want anything `from` you, $CADY, but I do want things `for` you. Friends are important, as are companions.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't want anything [color=#3b78e2][i]from[/i][/color] you, $CADY, but I do want things [color=#3b78e2][i]for[/i][/color] you. Friends are important, as are companions.

nodes.text: Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You know, getting the lay of the land. Once I get comfortable, I'll start branching out.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And if you never get comfortable...?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I've gotten by fine on my own so far.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Friends are important, $CADY, as are companions.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: I'll admit, there have difficulties, but if $CADY is willing to put in some additional effort, she may yet prove herself.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Let's hope that happens...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Frigo... Glaci... Alis!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Frigo... Glaci... Alis![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A small floating `ball of ice` appears in the palm of your hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: A small floating [b]ball of ice[/b] appears in the palm of your hand!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Hmm... This is twice now you've failed to cast a spell on your own. Perhaps I was mistaken about you...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, Professor, you weren't... Isn't there anything you can do?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Well, it's ill-advised, but...
Ang reaches into his pocket and pulls out his Flash Card. It radiates a blast of blinding white light!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Ow... `Again...?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ow... [color=#3b78e2][i]Again...?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Words unknown to you rush through your head. Your lips begin to speak...
A small floating ball of ice appears in the palm of your hand!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Focus on your feelings, $CADY, and try again. Remember... `Frigo... Glaci... Alis!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Focus on your feelings, $CADY, and try again. Remember... [color=#e23b3b][i]Frigo... Glaci... Alis![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Last time, we learned how to cast `Fire Render`, an essential spell for those magicians aligned with Chaos...
nodes.text_bbcode: Last time, we learned how to cast [color=#e23b3b][i]Fire Render[/i][/color], an essential spell for those magicians aligned with Chaos...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: This time, we'll learn `Ice Blast`, a spell aligned with Order. Now repeat after me...
nodes.text_bbcode: This time, we'll learn [color=#e23b3b][i]Ice Blast[/i][/color], a spell aligned with Order. Now repeat after me...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: `Frigo... Glaci... Alis!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Frigo... Glaci... Alis!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Whoops! Did I accidentally cast Ice Blast? Klutzy me!
You stumble awkwardly to your feet...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah? I'm about to accidentally cast a spell of my own. It's called 'Smash Your Head Into That Cabinet.'

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Ooh, I'm totally shaking.

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: You kind of are.

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Shut up, Meredith, it's the Ice Blast!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You're just lucky I'm running late...

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Yeah, you `are` late. How old are you? `...15?` `...16?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] late. How old are you? [color=#3b78e2][i]...15?[/i][/color] [color=#3b78e2][i]...16?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So what?

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: So everybody else at this school has been training since they were `8` years old. You really think you belong?
nodes.text_bbcode: So everybody else at this school has been training since they were [color=#3b78e2][i]8[/i][/color] years old. You really think you belong?

nodes.text: Minka flicks her fingers, directing a second flurry of snow in your direction. The snowflakes practically steam off your tense, reddening cheeks.

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Oh, and by the way, do yourself a favor. Keep away from Luke.
The two girls walk off. You watch them go, clenching and unclenching your fists...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Keep it cool, $CADY. Don't get expelled from `another` school...
nodes.text_bbcode: Keep it cool, $CADY. Don't get expelled from [color=#3b78e2][i]another[/i][/color] school...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This one's actually not all bad.
With an angry sigh, you turn and head off to class.
A few minutes later...
You dash down the hallway and burst through the door into the Spellcasting Classroom.
The seats are empty, the lights dim, and Spellmaster Ang speaks in hushed tones with a balding man in a rumpled sweater vest.

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: Which is of course what I thought! But I've checked everywhere, and the ingredients weren't simply misplaced... `They were taken!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which is of course what I thought! But I've checked everywhere, and the ingredients weren't simply misplaced... [color=#e23b3b][i]They were taken![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: You can't honestly believe it was `theft?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't honestly believe it was [color=#e23b3b][i]theft?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: I'm afraid so, but I can hardly understand it! The ingredients are only good for one potion, and who would `want` to brew a Faunafurreus Elixir? We'd have animals driven berserk, running around trying to murder people!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm afraid so, but I can hardly understand it! The ingredients are only good for one potion, and who would [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] to brew a Faunafurreus Elixir? We'd have animals driven berserk, running around trying to murder people!

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang glances over the shoulder of the balding man. He clears his throat to indicate your arrival to his peer.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Ahem... Apologies, Leopold, it seems my student has arrived for her lesson.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Potionsmaster Buttwerst, this is $CADY, our newest pupil here at SpellClaive Academy.

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: Yes, yes... Pleased to meet you, young lady.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Did I interrupt something?

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: No... I mean, yes--

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: But we were just finishing up, weren't we?

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: We were...?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Of course, we were...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Now $CADY, you'll be taking instruction from Professor Buttwerst next year, provided you master your introductory spells. He's very clever, this one!

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: That's a bit much...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Not in the slightest. But now if you'll excuse us, Leopold, we've got lessons to get to. And you need to get back to looking for the potions you've misplaced!

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: But I told you, I didn't misplace them!
Spellmaster Ang ushers Potionsmaster Butterwerst out into the hall. Before Buttwerst can finish his sentence, Ang pulls shut the door.
Ang turns back at you, grinning sheepishly.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Brilliant potioner, that man, but a wee bit scattered. Now where were we? Ah, that's right...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Whoa...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Whoa...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You flail your arms, spinning them like windmills, and manage to save yourself from sprawling butt first onto the ground.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ow!`
You tumble to the floor! Looking up, you see Minka flick her wrist, waving a small cloud of glimmering snow in your direction...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Bad enough that my sister and I are stuck here while the war rages in our home, but this condescension is simply too much to bear.
Arinna rises and places herself between you and Priam.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Priam, calm yourself. $CADY, perhaps it would be best if you and I spoke again another time...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, sure. Whatever you say, Princess.
You slink back into your empty room. As the door closes, the class schedule on the wall screeches like an owl...

nodes.speaker: Calendar
nodes.text: Late for class! Late for class!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, just perfect...
You race through the emptying halls, round a corner, and barrel directly into two popular girls. They shove you back...

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Hey! Watch where you're going!

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Yeah, we're walking here!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well, are you sorry for fawning all over Luke yesterday?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I was `not` fawning all over him...
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] fawning all over him...

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Oh please! Everyone could see you batting your big, dumb eyes at him!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, you know what? I do `not` need this...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, you know what? I do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] need this...

nodes.text: You push by and start to walk away. As you take a step, your foot hits an icy slick patch of floor...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `AHHH...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHH...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, it is... To imagine that my words might affect the rotation of the very heavens...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But perhaps it is just that. A story. A myth.
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So? Is that bad? Everybody needs to believe in something.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, I suppose you're right...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: In these trying times, I find the old ways comforting. That's what truly matters...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Maybe you would like to join me in greeting the morning?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Really?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I would not ask otherwise.
Arinna hands you several flowers and places the diadem back atop her head. She motions for you to take a kneeling position beside her. She raises her own bouquet skyward, and you copy her action.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Sum'naro Sol'awa...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sum'naro Sol'awa...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Kali'ama Katee... Katem Sol'wa--

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Sister. What do you think you're doing?
Still kneeling, you pivot to see Priam approach. He sneers, revealing elongated canines.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Answer me!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Priam, my roommate $CADY and I were--

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I saw what she was doing! She may have spoke our words, but a human will never be a Wildefolk.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I was doing my best!

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Best? Worst? Do you think it matters?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You're going to mumble `words`, and the sun is going to somehow hear that?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're going to mumble [color=#3b78e2][i]words[/i][/color], and the sun is going to somehow hear that?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh really? And what of the story your kind tells, of the great, red Wizard of the North who comes once a year bearing gifts and punishing sins? And what of these little gray men who travel your stars, seeking to probe hindquarters?
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah. Because people are dumb! When did this become breaking news?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Sister. What do you think you're doing?
You pivot to see Priam approach. He sneers, revealing elongated canines.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Answer me!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Priam, my roommate $CADY and I were--

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I saw what she was doing. She was making a complete mockery of our sacred traditions.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Our people are known by yours, but we are from a different world...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: One parallel to your own, very distant, but connected...
You motion toward the garden...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What were you doing?
Arinna removes a bejeweled diadem from atop her head.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: This ritual and this diadem... They are part of the the `Mo'anna Invocation.` These are words spoken by my people to greet the dawn of each new day.
nodes.text_bbcode: This ritual and this diadem... They are part of the the [color=#3b78e2][i]Mo'anna Invocation.[/i][/color] These are words spoken by my people to greet the dawn of each new day.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Our legends say that if the words of Mo'anna are forsaken on the same day by all Wildefolk, if `no one` greets the dawn...
nodes.text_bbcode: Our legends say that if the words of Mo'anna are forsaken on the same day by all Wildefolk, if [color=#3b78e2][i]no one[/i][/color] greets the dawn...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Then on that day, the sun will rise never again.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Really? So some magic words are what makes the sun rise?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Elves. Imps. The fair folk. My people have been called many names by your people...
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So I was right. You are elves?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: We prefer the term Wildefolk, but yes...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Bloodsuckers. Nosferatu. Dracula. Creatures who drink the blood of your people? You think I resemble such fiends?
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Kinda! Why do you make that sound like a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Well, you have nothing to fear... It is daylight, is it not? And besides, the Wildefolk have not dined on human flesh in centuries.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's less comforting than I think you were going for.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And our kingdom is but a memory...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Kingdom?` I totally forgot that you were--
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kingdom?[/i][/color] I totally forgot that you were--

nodes.text: Instinctively, you lean forward, almost bowing.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Please... There's no need to supplicate yourself before me.
Arinna rises with superhuman speed. Her face moves into the sunlight, and her alabaster skin glimmers. As she speaks, her lips move, revealing elongated canines. She extends her hand to shake.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I am sorry we did not get a chance to speak yesterday. My brother guards my safety to a fault...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I am Princess Arinna T'Karra of the Wilde... And you are?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh! You're some kind of...
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'd rather not be reminded of how happy I was, just so I can be reminded of how awful things are now...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, you could look at your life that way, and I'd be lying if I said that I was not tempted to do so myself.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So you think I'm right?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I'm saying that I understand...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: War ravages my world. Many I cared for deeply have already been lost. And now, my brother Priam and I are refugees here...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Of course. You're like my brother. All the suffering he's endured, and he chooses to carry the burden alone.
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Suffering?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: War ravages our world. Many we cared for deeply have already been lost. And now, my brother Priam and I are refugees here...
You jolt awake, finding yourself in your old bed, wrapped up in blankets with a familiar, clean dryer sheet smell.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Wha...
You're at the door in a flash! You throw it open, expecting to hear the sizzle of bacon frying in the kitchen or the sound of your brother playing a videogame.
But instead you look out into an unfamiliar living area.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm... I'm still at school...
You slump back inside your room and take a seat on the bed.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It's not real. This room is just a stupid illusion. I don't even know what it really looks like...
The walls quiver and reorient. The posters and the walls fade away, until only a class schedule remains.
In less than a moment, you are sitting on a plain bed in an almost empty room.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, I guess that solves that...
You throw on clothes and step outside, sucking in the brisk, early morning air...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This place is so weird...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Oh, I've seen that look before...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Who... Who said that...?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Over here.
You peek around the corner of the building. Arinna kneels along the edge of an immaculately maintained garden. She faces away...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I wore that exact same expression after my first night here. When I woke, I thought for a moment that I was home again, but then I realized it was all just an illusion.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: For a moment, I was filled with all the pain and loss I thought I'd gotten over.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah. Not exactly the coolest...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But after I'd thought on it, I realized that a memory of home was better than no home at all.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I appreciate the advice, but my home...
Frigo...
Glaci...
Ignis...
Confla...
Aura...
Vor...
Tempe...
Ful...
Gem...
Inara...
Obs...
Scura...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I don't know. It just happened. Like...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Like magic?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So magic is real? Like `really` real.
nodes.text_bbcode: So magic is real? Like [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] real.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Very much so. It's everywhere, all around us, inside me, and also...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: ...Inside `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Inside [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Cromwell extends her hands and takes yours gently. Cool energy passes through her fingertips and surges into your palms.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Your home was taken from you by a terrible tragedy, $CADY, but believe me, when I tell you that you've found a new home here. How does that sound?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It... It sounds...
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I did it!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Yes, you did! Excellent!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Remember, think of spellcasting as a muscle. Keep exercising, and your spells will be stronger and last longer. Any questions?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Only like a thousand and one!
From across the room, among Spellmaster Ang's possessions, comes a tiny warbling that rises to a guttural growl.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Well, ahem... Unfortunately, that's all the time we have for today. Run along!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But Spellmaster Ang...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
