nodes.text: Who's the instructor here? I said, class dismissed!
Again, nothing happens.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It... It still didn't work...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: No matter. Many students have trouble at the beginning, which is why I've created a simple study aid... A Flash Card!
Spellmaster Ang reaches into his pocket... And pulls out a small white index card. It explodes with blinding white light!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Ow... What was that? What did you do to--
Words unknown to you fill your head. Your lips begin to speak.
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I did it... But how?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: With the aid of a little mental magic, just enough to get you started...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: But this is the last time I can assist you. Too much time with Flash Cards can literally drive a magician insane...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Well, no... Not `insane.` That sounds too pleasant.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, no... Not [color=#e23b3b][i]insane.[/i][/color] That sounds too pleasant.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: I'm trying to think of a word that describes a crazy person who rambles senselessly while rolling around in her own filth...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Lunatic?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Yes! That's it! And we wouldn't want that to happen to a sweet girl like you, would we?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Probably not...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Not to worry. Think of spellcasting as a muscle. Keep exercising, and your spells will become stronger and last longer. Any questions?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Only like a thousand and one!
From across the rooms, among Spellmaster Ang's possessions, comes a tiny warbling that rises to a growl.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Well, ahem... Unfortunately, that's all the time we have for today. Run along!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But Spellmaster Ang...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Who's the instructor here? I said, class dismissed!
You exit the classroom and step outside into the quad. Your eyes scan across the busy campus, moving from one cluster of students to the next...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No faces I recognize and no idea where I'm supposed to go. I guess some things never change...
The short, goofy-looking guy you met at your old school runs up.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hey! $CADY, over here!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, hi... It was Silas, right? ...Er, `Sidney?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, hi... It was Silas, right? ...Er, [color=#3b78e2][i]Sidney?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Actually, `Simon...` Although I'm not surprised that you don't remember. Not with Luke around. Even I have to admit the guy is pretty cool.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, [color=#e23b3b][i]Simon...[/i][/color] Although I'm not surprised that you don't remember. Not with Luke around. Even I have to admit the guy is pretty cool.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: All the girls really seem to think so...
You hop down the steps and start walking aimlessly across the quad. Simon races to catch up with you and gets jostled between several other students walking in the opposite direction.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Wait! I'm supposed to show you to where you'll be staying...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So my new room...?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Your new `suite`, actually. You have your own room, but you'll share a living area.
nodes.text_bbcode: Your new [color=#e23b3b][i]suite[/i][/color], actually. You have your own room, but you'll share a living area.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sounds fancy... Does everybody here get a suite?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You're the second new student to show up unexpectedly in the middle of the year, and they kind of had to squeeze you in.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: So that means you and Arinna get to share a converted faculty residence.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And `Arinna?` She's my new roommate?
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]Arinna?[/i][/color] She's my new roommate?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Kind of a funny name. Is she from another country?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That's an understatement...
Simon points to a squat, rectangular building with a moss-covered stone facing. He opens a door leading into a hallway and then leads you through to a suite at the far end.
The living area is large, with couches, a television, and a view of the campus. There is a kitchenette. On each side of the room is a door leading to a bedroom.
One of the doors is ajar, allowing you to look into a palatial bedroom ornamented with gleaming crimson and golden fabric. A familiar face peers out...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: You...
Behind Priam is a slender blonde girl in flowing, white robes.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh! She's not human either!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh hey, Priam... Just showing Arinna's new roommate to her bedroom. Did you or your sister want to meet her?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, Simon! I think that would be very--

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: We've `already` met, and besides, introductions would be pointless...
nodes.text_bbcode: We've [color=#e23b3b][i]already[/i][/color] met, and besides, introductions would be pointless...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: So long as I am in charge of the safety of my sister, she will not be sharing a residence with this girl or anyone else.
Priam moves in front of Arinna and slams the door shut! You and Simon stand in awkward silence, until you quip...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yep. Still friendly...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: He's supposed to be a decent guy when you get to know him. Or so I'm told...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Arinna, on the other hand, is just so funny and elegant. I showed her around campus when she arrived, you know...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Simon, are you trying to tell me that...

options.label: You have a crush on her?
That I should be her friend?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Heh... You're pretty quick for a noob!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: As to the rest, we get you to Headmaster Cromwell, and she can explain everything.
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I did it!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Yes, very good... You seem to be getting the hang of this!
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I did it...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Not without help, unfortunately... We should hope that using the Flash Card a second time hasn't caused too much brain damage...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Too much?` You mean there was definitely `some` brain damage?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Too much?[/i][/color] You mean there was definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] brain damage?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Oh yes. Almost certainly...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: But the symptoms should be hardly noticeable, and on the bright side, you've learned a second spell...
Headmaster Cromwell opens the door wide and motions for you to follow her out.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Spellmaster, if you've finished with your tutorial, might I borrow $CADY for the rest of the hour?
Ang bows gracefully.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: But of course! Anything for you, Headmaster!
A few minutes later...
You and the Headmaster stroll across the school grounds.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, now that you've learned two spells, you'll need to start thinking about which alignment you'd prefer. On the day of the Hecate, you'll make your final decision.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What happens if I `don't?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What happens if I [color=#3b78e2][i]don't?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You don't have to `do` anything. You could just squander your potential by mastering spells of neither alignment. Then after a long, unfulfilling career as a subpar wizard, you could retire and no one at all would miss you. How does that sound?
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't have to [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] anything. You could just squander your potential by mastering spells of neither alignment. Then after a long, unfulfilling career as a subpar wizard, you could retire and no one at all would miss you. How does that sound?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Like you're laying it on a little thick?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Not at all, $CADY. This is an important choice, and one every magician must make. You should do so thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's me, always thinking things through...
Cromwell nods thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I must confess, I also had another reason for speaking with you. I wanted to see how you were fitting in.
You continue practicing the spell. After about an hour, the door to the classroom opens up, and Headmaster Cromwell peeks her head inside...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang, I was just checking in on $CADY's progress. How's she done so far?

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Good. Final word: `Appareo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Good. Final word: [color=#e23b3b][i]Appareo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Okay. Never mind. Guess it's up to me... `Aspi Idos Appareo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay. Never mind. Guess it's up to me... [color=#e23b3b][i]Aspi Idos Appareo![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What did you just do?

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Wait for it... Wait for it...

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: `EEEEEEKKK!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]EEEEEEKKK!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You stumble over the word.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh...
You back away and then turn, tearing down the sidewalk and racing out into the circle drive.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: No, $CADY, watch out for the--
You turn just in time to realize you've stepped right in the path of an SUV! The student behind the wheel slams the brakes, but it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No!
Luke leaps forward, shoves his hand in front of him. In it, is an old, antique `pocket watch.` He clicks it open--
nodes.text_bbcode: Luke leaps forward, shoves his hand in front of him. In it, is an old, antique [b]pocket watch.[/b] He clicks it open--

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `Chronos!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Chronos![/i][/color]

nodes.text: There is a brilliant flash of light!

And the world slows to a crawl. The SUV still lumbers ahead, but now it travels at a snail's pace. Birds hang frozen in the sky like ornaments on a windless mobile. Classmates look your way with blank, surprised expressions.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What... What just...?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I'll explain later. We need to move!

Luke yanks you out of the street. An instant later, time jolts forward again. The SUV screeches to a halt three feet past where you were standing only a moment before. A short, goofy-looking guy runs up.

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Whoa, Luke, that was close. Are you two okay?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yeah. Had to burn off the last few seconds of my Clockstopper Incantation though. Next time, you can be the point of contact, and I'll spectate from the sidelines.
You look back to the confused SUV driver, and then the students on the sidewalk backing away from the uncoiling snake.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Seriously, who `are` you people?
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously, who [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] you people?

nodes.speaker: Guy
nodes.text: Luke, you didn't `tell` her?
nodes.text_bbcode: Luke, you didn't [color=#e23b3b][i]tell[/i][/color] her?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I was trying to, Simon, but as you can see, things got a little out of hand.
School administrators rush out from the building, and students point your way. Simon quickly puts a hand on your shoulder and guides you in the other direction.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, okay... Look, $CADY, we're kind of on a schedule, so here's the rundown. You've been accepted into a `new school`, and we were sent here to fetch you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, okay... Look, $CADY, we're kind of on a schedule, so here's the rundown. You've been accepted into a [color=#e23b3b][i]new school[/i][/color], and we were sent here to fetch you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: New school? Again? Wait, you guys are too young to be `social workers... `
nodes.text_bbcode: New school? Again? Wait, you guys are too young to be [color=#3b78e2][i]social workers... [/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Does my foster family know about this?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Not exactly?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: $CADY, the thing is... We're `magic users`, just like you. Well, maybe a little more experienced than you, but you know what I mean...
nodes.text_bbcode: $CADY, the thing is... We're [color=#e23b3b][i]magic users[/i][/color], just like you. Well, maybe a little more experienced than you, but you know what I mean...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Our headmaster wants you to come to `school` with us.
nodes.text_bbcode: Our headmaster wants you to come to [color=#e23b3b][i]school[/i][/color] with us.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No... Get away from me! What did you just `do?`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... Get away from me! What did you just [color=#3b78e2][i]do?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I was just trying to--
Chloe jerks her hand back and drops the messenger bag to the ground. A sleek, black snake slithers out and flicks its forked tongue. Chloe jumps away!

nodes.speaker: Chloe
nodes.text: You had a snake in your bag?! You're... You're a freaking lunatic!
Chloe and her friends run off shrieking!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Sorry about that. Couldn't help myself. Name's `Luke`, by the way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry about that. Couldn't help myself. Name's [color=#e23b3b][i]Luke[/i][/color], by the way.

nodes.text: He extends his hand. You bat it to the side.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Luke...` Names tend to stick when I pass out in the backseat of a guy's car...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Luke...[/i][/color] Names tend to stick when I pass out in the backseat of a guy's car...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey, it's not my fault you couldn't handle my ride!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ahem! Both of you! Run along to class!
Luke grins and steps to the side, letting you pass. Cromwell nods to him, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: No problem. Right this way.
A few minutes later...

Luke guides you down a long, arched hallway. On either side are classrooms where students make wild gestures and call out words, creating bursts of light and smoke. Spaced between the doors are large canvases that display images of former students and their accomplishments.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: ...And down that way is the library, which is where you can check out all your scrolls, grimoires, and other spell-books...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: ...And the other way is the Enchantery and the Hexadrome...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: ...And then around that far corner is the Alchemy lab, the apiary, the herb garden, and the magical bowling alley...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Seriously?` And what's next? A haunted hair salon?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Seriously?[/i][/color] And what's next? A haunted hair salon?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Actually, now that you mention it...
You almost start to laugh and then catch yourself.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Heh... Was that a smile?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...No.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey, it's okay. This place is crazy, and the first few days seem totally nuts. But so far, you've had it easy. On my first day, I tried to talk, and all that came out were little pink hearts!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...What?!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yeah! Turns out this girl had a crush on me and totally messed up a love spell. Every time I tried to say a word, hearts and glitter would just come pouring out.

options.label: Remind me not to kiss you.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Before you can be enrolled, you must do one last thing. Sign your name here on the class registry.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Right here on the line?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Yes. Well...?
You look up to where the beast was, but it isn't there! Just a red, blinking traffic light!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whu... Where...?
Behind you sprawls an overturned tractor trailer, jack-knifed halfway off the road. Its grill spews grey smoke. Past that are fire trucks and ambulances.
Emergency workers scurry by you, moving toward an overturned passenger sedan... `Your family's` sedan.
nodes.text_bbcode: Emergency workers scurry by you, moving toward an overturned passenger sedan... [b]Your family's[/b] sedan.

nodes.text: Its windows are shattered, its roof is caved in, and through the cracked glass, you can almost see...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Mom... Brian...?
You stumble to your feet, then topple over, weeping. Emergency workers spy you and rush over, laying caring hands upon you. A pen light shines in your eyes, fingers check your pulse...
Snippets of conversations float around you, phrases like 'must've been thrown from the vehicle' and 'lucky to be alive'...
Snippets of conversations float around you, phrases like 'must've been thrown from the vehicle', 'lucky to be alive', and 'looks like a cracked rib'...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Please... My mom... My brother... Are they okay?
An EMT starts to answer your question and freezes, his words choking in his throat. His sad, mournful eyes are all the answer you need.
Your mother and brother are not okay...
And things will never be okay again.

Your mother and brother are not okay...
And things will never be okay again.
You look up to the cliff you fell from, but it isn't there! Just a red, blinking traffic light!

args.text: What do you want to do?
You've reached the end of Magic School Book 1.
Your final score is %d out of 100 points.
Your final alignment is %d% Chaos and %d% Order.
Your final alignment is %d% Order and %d% Chaos.
What do you want to do?
I warned you about making jokes, $CADY. Your familiar will now be called `Snerdle!`
Snerdle? But isn't that kind of...?
...Kind of what? That's my pa's name.
Oh... I meant, isn't it kind of... Perfect?
Yes, it is... Ain't that right, Snerdle?
This ain't the time for funning, $CADY. Pick a `real` name, or I'll pick a name for you.
I take it you're my new student?
I take it you're the teacher who forgets to lock up the wild animals?
Don't sass me, girl. That gryphon was penned when I left. Now I asked you a question.
Yes, I'm the new student. My name is $CADY.
All right then. My name's Kimuko Lee. I teach Animal Mastery...
And one of the first lessons is to `never` enter the Bestiary without supervision.
You're putting this on me? Have `you` heard of locking the door?
The stable door `was` left unlocked?! You're absolutely sure?
Either that, or I break into nasty animal pens for funzies.
Kimuko's eyes narrow, and she eyes you quizzically.
Then her scrutinizing gaze relaxes. She turns her attention to Luke.
Don't just stand there like sage grass, Luke. Help the lady to her feet.
Luke holds out his hand. You reluctantly take it, and he pulls you to your feet with one powerful tug.
You know... This is the second time I've helped you out of a jam. Keep this up, and I might start to think you're trying to get my attention.
You wish! Besides, I wouldn't want to cut in line ahead of your groupies.
Listen, $CADY, about those girls the other day--
Beastmaster Kimuko coughs. You and Luke turn to her.
Then she's probably fine. Don't you have a class to get to?
You keep walking, not slowing down. Luke rushes to catch up with you.
Hold up. I just heard what happened with Minka and Meredith today...
Why? You didn't do anything wrong.
Yeah, actually, I did. I shouldn't have led Minka on like that... And I probably shouldn't have hooked up with Meredith at the All Hallow's party...
And I `definitely` shouldn't have used that Deceitful Double spell instead of just telling them I wasn't interested. There was no way `that` wasn't going to backfire.
I only know two spells, and even `I` could've told you that.
Look... I know I've got kind of a reputation here. And I'm not saying it's not deserved. But that doesn't mean that's `all` I am. Just like your reputation isn't all that `you` are.
Sure! You're kind of getting a rep for causing trouble, not that it's much of a surprise given how we met...
You glance down at your wrist. The gem on your bracelet is now an opulent, arterial crimson.
Sure! You're kind of getting a rep for being a goody-goody, which is surprising, given how we met...
You glance down at your wrist. The gem on your bracelet is now a rich, deep-ocean blue.
Plus everybody is talking about how you spell-smacked that gryphon with Fire Render right in the face!
Plus everybody is talking about how you spell-smacked that gryphon with Ice Blast right in the face!
Eh, just a little thing I do...
My point is this, you seem like a cool girl, $CADY. You seem... Real... In a way most people here aren't.
And I want to be your friend.
Sorry, Luke. But I don't think I'm ready for that.
Can I at least meet your familiar?
Yeah, yeah. Just don't try to make out with her.
You wave your hand. $NAMEOFFAMILIAR swoops down and lands on your shoulder. She eyes Luke warily.
You reach down and shake his hand.
I think I'm okay with that.
But try anything funny, and I swear I'll sic $NAMEOFFAMILIAR on you!
Your familiar swoops in from behind you, and alights gently on your shoulder. She glares at Luke, baring sharp fangs!
Whoa! That is an awesome familiar!
Yeah? What's yours? Some kind of kissing panda?
First of all, kissing pandas were declared illegal as familiars after the great mono outbreak of 1942...
And second, you've actually already met `my` familiar...
Luke whispers a few quick syllables, and something in his shoulder bag begins to writhe. A moment later, a snake pops out.
His name is Cornelius. What about yours?

Cornelius coils up Luke's arm, extends camouflaged, gossamer-thin wings, and then buzzes up into the air! $NAMEOFFAMILIAR burbles happily and takes off after him! The two animals gambol in the updrafts, zipping and weaving through the treetops like sparrows courting!
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR suddenly divebombs, buzzing low and zipping at full blast right by Minka and Meredith...
Minka jumps and stumbles into Meredith. The two topple into the bushes along the edge of the path.
Whoa... That was cool! How'd $NAMEOFFAMILIAR know to do that?
Well, she is a part of you!
Cornelius and $NAMEOFFAMILIAR continue to frolic, until they finally return exhausted to you and Luke. The two familiars collapse against each other, huffing contentedly...
Aww... Looks like the cute little lady made a friend.
You look up to the creature, your eyes lit up with defiance! There's nowhere to run, no place to hide. This is where you'll make your stand...
A tiny tingle rises in the pit of your stomach, and power surges down into your fingertips.
`Magic...` I totally forgot about my spells...
Listen closely. The words for `Fire Render` are `Ignis... Confla... Gratus!`
And the words for `Ice Blast` are `Frigo... Glaci... Alis!` Now did you get all that?
You square your shoulders to the gryphon, assuming a strong spellcasting pose.
The gryphon arches back and lunges for your throat--
At the last second, you raise your hands ahead and cast a magic spell--
You fumble the words! The gryphon's mouth opens wide, revealing rows of tiny, lizard-like teeth! Its tongue flails! Its jaws flex to bite down and--

You cast `Ice Blast!`  A windstorm of ice erupts from your fingertips! The gryphon stumbles back, shrieking plaintively, shaking its head from side to side, its beak muzzled inside a cone of blue-white ice.

You cast `Fire Render!` A plume of fire explodes from your fingertips! The gryphon stumbles back, shrieking plaintively, shaking its head from side to side. Singed feathers fall around you like autumn leaves.
I did it! That's what I'm talking ab--
The gryphon gnashes, and its ice muzzle shatters! It turns to you, angry amber eyes framed by a thin layer of frost...
The gryphon looks up at you, its angry amber eyes framed by a thin layer of ash...
The gryphon lunges again, before you can ready another spell. Its mouth opens wide, revealing rows of tiny, lizard-like teeth! Its tongue flails! Its jaws flex to bite down and--

You step into your living room, and are immediately hit with one of the most delicious, incredible smells you've ever encountered. It's freshly baked cookies, chocolate fudge, and big, juicy strawberries, all mixed into one.
You round the corner. There, in the kitchen, Arinna, futzing over a tray of what look like the biggest, most fluffy scones you've ever seen.
Oh, hello, $CADY! These are a delicacy among my people... Or as close as I can make with the ingredients of your world.
My people call them Delika'Zoranoel. The Bread Which Makes One Remember A Childhood Long Forgotten...
Although your fellow classmates call them `Ohemmgee.`
Arinna offers you one. You take a bite...
Yes! That was exactly what they said! Would you like to help me make more?
I'd like to `eat` more, but what about your surly big bro?
Occupied for the evening... With security concerns. Are you with me, $CADY?
The two of you work late into the evening, baking, snacking, and laughing...
And long after midnight, you return to your room. $NAMEOFFAMILIAR scurries into the corner, shivering slightly in a draft...
Guess there's not much furniture in here to cuddle up in, is there?
You sit on the plain bed and stare across the empty room at the bare, white walls. Almost without thinking, you find yourself saying...
'A memory of home is better than no home at all'...

The walls quiver, and suddenly, you're sitting in your old room again, with all the same posters and decorations. $NAMEOFFAMILIAR jumps onto the bed next to you, nuzzling contentedly against your thigh.
Yeah, I guess this isn't so bad, after all...
It might not be home... Yet... But it's the best I've had in a long, long time.
You pat $NAMEOFFAMILIAR on the head and throw yourself back onto the bed. $NAMEOFFAMILIAR curls up beside you.
And soon, both you and your new companion snuggle together, drifting off into a long, peaceful, well-deserved night's sleep.
Elsewhere on campus, in the bowels of the school, a cloaked figure draws an ornate silver hand mirror from within the folds of fabric and utters arcane words...
The figure speaks into the glass. The reflective surface ripples and then solidifies, becoming a window into the Wilde...
Apologies for the delay, Master. I made contact as soon as I was able.
Our plan to eliminate Arinna moves on schedule. The keys to the Bestiary have been acquired.
In the glass is a dark magician made of living shadow, sitting on his throne inside his cavernous mountain keep...
You're late with your report, `vermin.` And what of the rest of my plan?
The ingredients for the Faunafurreus elixir have been acquired. All that's left to complete our plan is to--
Do not presume to tell me my own strategy! I am the seed of Darkness. The prince of Infernals. My every sinful thought is made manifest.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to presume--
No... No, you did not. But if you presume to `breathe` henceforth, you'll see my instructions carried through.
The surface of the glass ripples one last time, then solidifies, a mirror once more.
And in another world, in the deepest, darkest heart of the Wilde...
The magician made of shadow rises from his throne and steps to the balcony where he gazes out upon his treacherous, volcanic kingdom.
In the valley beneath, an army of raucous, gruesome creatures are encamped. The magician ponders quietly, speaking to no one but himself.
Soon... Soon the girl will be `no more`, and then... Then all of the Wilde will belong to me!
As if in agreement, high overhead, a dragon shrieks fire!
You put yourself close to the bars, examining the caged animals closely.
Kimuko unlocks the cage and pulls out the $TYPEOFFAMILIAR. She puts it in your arms. She then places one hand on its head and the other on yours.
A surge of energy races through you, and when you look down, your familiar gazes up at you with new recognition.
It's... It's like she knows me!
It's more than that. Your $TYPEOFFAMILIAR is part of you now. To complete the bonding ritual, there's just one more thing you have to do.
Okay, I think I'm going to call you...
A powerful bolt of energy comes from the doorway behind you!
The creature stiffens as the blast hits, teeters like a top that's spun its course, and drops, coming right at you!
Luke lunges from the doorway and pulls you clear!
Just inches from your feet, the gryphon smashes down, snoring with a rumble like a freight train!

You look up to Luke and then to the doorway. There, a tall, gorgeous Native American woman in a leather duster peers down at you sternly. She holds up her finger to her lips and blows away a plume of smoke.
What do you want to do?

After Luke has moved on to his next class, you wait by yourself while Beastmaster Kimuko returns the gryphon to its cage. A few moments later, she steps back into the stables and pulls off her work gloves.
You still got that boot Hermes was gnawing on, $CADY?
You look down at your shoes. The leather of the right one is slightly gnawed on.
Wouldn't want to let Hermes keep it. If a gryphon has your scent, it can track you anywhere. Bloodhounds with beaks!
Beastmaster Kimuko pats down the pockets of her duster.
Now where are those blasted keys of mine? I swear, losing my keys, leaving the door to the Bestiary open. Next I'll be misplacing my head.
Beastmaster Kimuko locates a spare set of brass keys in a nearby drawer.
Anyhow, now that the bird is in its nest, so to speak, we can get down to business...
And my business is `creatures`, big and small. Turns out nearly every mythical beast or legend you ever heard of is true.
Most of the really feisty ones are native to the Wilde, like your new friend, the gryphon.
Yep. Them too, since you asked.
Most species from the Wilde are untamable, but magicians have taken a shine to certain species over the years. They keep them as `familiars.` Now's your chance to select your own.
Beastmaster Kimuko leads you to the rear of the stables. There, she points to several small cages, each containing a different animal.
Dragons are cold-blooded. They're not much for snuggling, but they are intelligent and wield tremendous power if properly trained.
Birdmonkeys are pranksterish, always getting into trouble, but don't let that fool you. They're also fiercely loyal.
Flying pigs never get much bigger than piglets, but their hearts are absolutely enormous. They love to snuggle, and they're very affectionate.
Eagle Badgers are keen observers, muscular, and always good in a brawl.
Cat bats are cunning, clever, and intensely curious. They're best for wizards who appreciate nocturnal excursions.
Any idea which familiar you want?
So I shouldn't just close my eyes and go 'Eeny Meeny Miny Moe'?
I guess that'd be one way to pick, but do remember, whatever familiar you choose will become part of you forever.
There is a sudden flutter of wings, and a thump as something heavy touches down on the opposite side of the wall behind you.
There's a deafening screech! A shadow visible in the spaces between the wooden slats shifts, then lunges forward...
In front of you, something large and heavy bursts through the wall like a cannonball! Splinters and jagged pieces of wood shoot forward...
And dig trenches into the exposed skin on your arms and neck!
You raise your hands to cover your eyes and scramble backward. Your heel catches in the soft earth of the stable floor, and you trip!
An enormous beast with the crown and wings of an eagle and the frame of a lion looms over you... A `gryphon!`
A hot blast of steamy breath scorches the back of your neck, and then...
You spin around and leap back!
Behind you, something large and heavy bursts through the wall like a cannonball! Splinters and jagged pieces of wood shoot forward...
Zinging through the air where you stood only a second ago!

On the opposite side of SpellClaive, Headmaster Cromwell looks up from the busy slide of word and symbols across the paper on her desk. She rises and steps over to the window, making a sly conductor motion with her hand that causes the window to open all by itself...
The breeze pushes its way inside, as do the tinny echoes of your terrible, pained screams...
Headmaster Cromwell is not alone in hearing you. Others do too. Spellmaster Ang, for one...
Probably just another prank gone wrong...
Uh oh, that doesn't sound very good...
Such anguish! I've heard similar wails before, on the Marrow Fields of Rahk'Azhul...
What are you all waiting for? Someone needs help! Move!
But though many hear, not one arrives in time to save you from your fate.
An enormous beast with the crown and wings of an eagle and the frame of a lion looms over you... A `gryphon!`
You quickly glance from side to side. Just to the left is a rack with several animal handling tools. You scramble over and grab a...
You grab the rope netting and hurl it at the beast! The gryphon is ensnared!
The gryphon bucks, flexes its wings, and gnashes its beak! The ropes begins to fray... `Then break!`
But not before you turn away...
And flee deeper into the stables, passing through a door marked `'CAUTION: DANGEROUS CREATURES'...` Then through a second door with a sign that reads, `'NOT FOR STUDENTS. KEEP OUT!'...`
And then finally through a third door marked with a sign that reads, `'DON'T SAY WE DIDN'T WARN YOU!'`
You enter a dimly lit room and stop dead in your tracks. It's a `dead end...`
To your left is a floor-to-ceiling water-tank, and inside it is an enormous, coiling eight-headed serpent. Several heads turn toward you, their black beady eyes glaring.
To your right is a cage with thick steel bars. Inside is an enormous boar-like creature with a bristling razor-like mane that runs the full length of its back! Its long tail ends in a heavy hook!
Directly ahead is a massive wolf with broad, heavily-muscled shoulders that support three sinewy heads and necks. The tri-headed wolf pulls against the chain that holds it to the wall.
There is a crash as doors are wrenched off their hinges behind you, and the gryphon bursts into the room after you. Its beak gnashes at your face!
You jump to the left and slide up against the cool glass enclosure!
Inside, the serpent writhes, striking its heads impotently against the glass, harmlessly gnashing its many mouths...
You double back toward the door you came in, but a mighty beak snaps down on your foot and jerks you back!
The gryphon pulls you up into the air by your heel!
Kick off your shoe!|Kick at its head!
With your free foot, you frantically kick at the shoe on your other foot!
It comes off, and you collapse to the floor with a thud!
Your lungs rack for air, and you can barely even raise your head. There's nowhere to run, no place to hide. Not that it matters, the panicked chase has completely sapped your will to survive...
Just... Just get it over with...
With your free foot, you kick at the creature's head!
At the last second, with your free foot, you kick at the creature's head!
It shakes you angrily from side to side, whipping your body back and forth like a high-pressure hose!
Until your foot works free from your shoe! You fall to the ground with a thud!
You jump to the right and slide against metal bars!
You feel a gust of foul, fetid air blow against the back of your neck. Behind you, the massive boar sniffs hungrily, rolling back its lips to show yellowed teeth...
The boar lunges forward, biting, and thuds against the frame of its enclosure. There's a moment of a relief, and then its tail arcs easily through the bars, coming right at you!
The tail's hook latches onto the sleeve of your shirt and pulls, drawing you closer to the boar's slavering jaws. You rip free!
You jump forward and slide away!
Beneath your hands, the floor is sticky and pungent, with the odor of rotting meat. A dollop of clear liquid splashes down next to you...
Tracing its descent, you look up to find three drooling wolf heads, their black nostrils sniffing at your hair...
You scramble back... But you're an instant too late! One of the head bites down on the sleeve of your shirt, pulling you back! You rip free!
You grab the hooked pole, turn toward the gryphon, and jab it at the beast's face and neck!
At the last second, you grab the hooked pole from the wall and jab it at the gryphon's face and neck!
The gryphon grabs the shaft in its massive jaws, yanks, and pulls the pole right out from your hands!
It bites down... `CRACK!` The pole splinters into two useless sections!
The gryphon shrieks defiantly, and then charges towards you! At the very last second, you duck away, roll clear...

There you go. Just in case your new friend ever gets lost.
Kimuko loads you down with food, toys, and other miscellaneous supplies and then waves you off...

nodes.text: The tingle moving down your arms dissipates.
The tingle moving into your fingertips dissipates.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh... No! What did you just do to me?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Me? No. You were the one who--
Your fingers tingle, and you remember the words you were instructed to speak.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Am I?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You mean that was a spell? `I` made that snake appear?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean that was a spell? [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] made that snake appear?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Is that right? What about the snake earlier? How did it appear?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I don't know. I just said `words` and...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know. I just said [color=#3b78e2][i]words[/i][/color] and...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: ...And?
There is a small disturbance in the air over your palm, as if the air itself had grown thick, and then `NOTHING...`

nodes.text: As you answer, the ice melts away, then drips into nothingness!
Early one Monday morning...
You're in your room, getting ready for school when you hear a knock on the door. Your mother peeks in...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Sweetie, guess what came in the mail for you!
She hands you an envelope. From the return address, you see it's from the Department of Motor Vehicles. You rip it open and pull out your brand-new driver's license.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You should double-check the spelling to make sure they got your name right.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And what about the photo, $CADY? How does it look?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It's actually not bad!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I agree! I had the worst photo on my ID when I was your age. All my friends wanted to see it, and I was so embarrassed to show them. But your photo looks so pretty and grown up. I bet all the cute boys will be chasing after you!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Mom!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I know, I know... Anyway, are you ready for school?
You pick up your backpack and swing it over your shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yep! All set! Can I drive?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Nice try! You know you're not allowed to drive with your little brother in the car until you're 18!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I was hoping you'd forgotten about that law...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: A mother never forgets. Now come on! Let's get going!
A few minutes later...
Your mother guides the family sedan out of the driveway and steers it through your neighborhood.
You ride shotgun, trying to ignore the rapid-fire thumping of your brother kicking at the back of your seat.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Cut it out! You're such a loser!

nodes.speaker: Brother
nodes.text: What? I'm not doing anything.
Your brother kicks the seat several more times!

nodes.speaker: Brother
nodes.text: Hee! Hee!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Brian, stop tormenting your sister. And $CADY, don't insult your brother.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Don't blame me. This wouldn't be happening if you'd let me drive.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You know the rules. You're just going to have to wait until after school and on the weekends to practice.

options.label: So? Who cares about the rules?

nodes.text: Last time, we learned how to cast `Ice Blast`, an essential spell for those magicians aligned with Order...
nodes.text_bbcode: Last time, we learned how to cast [color=#e23b3b][i]Ice Blast[/i][/color], an essential spell for those magicians aligned with Order...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: This time, we'll learn `Fire Render`, a spell aligned with Chaos. Now repeat after me...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It... It still didn't work...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: No matter. Many students have trouble at the beginning, which is why I've created a simple study aid... A Flash Card!
Spellmaster Ang reaches into his pocket... And pulls out a small white index card. It explodes with blinding white light!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Ow... What was that? What did you do to...?
Words unknown to you rush through your head. Your lips begin to speak.
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I did it... But how?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: With the aid of a little mental magic, just enough to get you started...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: But this is the last time I can assist you. Too much time with Flash Cards can literally drive you insane...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Well, no... Not `insane.` That sounds too pleasant.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, no... Not [color=#e23b3b][i]insane.[/i][/color] That sounds too pleasant.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: I'm trying to think of a word that describes a crazy person who rambles senselessly while rolling around in her own filth...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Lunatic?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Yes! That's it precisely! And we wouldn't want that to happen to a sweet girl like you, would we?

nodes.text: So far, she's been exceptional. If she keeps up the good work, we may have a new candidate for spell demonstration at the Spring Dance!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Excellent! That's good to hear...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Of course, I would be remiss if I didn't at least partially credit my excellent instruction.

nodes.text: I'll admit, there's been a bump or two, but overall, I believe she's getting the hang of it...
